method: Scoped page-4 divider transcription. The first 300/600 dpi read preceded KiCad inspection; after a model discrepancy, a 1200 dpi crop corrected the resistor label and separated the adjacent EHT trace. This is not a whole-page independent second netlist.

reread_after_diff.initial_error: The first read called the upper resistor R28 and joined its top to EHT. The KiCad comparison disagreed: R28 is the brightness potentiometer and the upper screen-divider resistor is R29.
reread_after_diff.source_resolution: The 1200 dpi crop shows R29's input line below the V21/EHT line, with no junction between them. R29/R30/R31 and the parallel R32 focus potentiometer are visible in order.
reread_after_diff.outcome: Corrected the scoped source netlist; no KiCad branch edit warranted.
